finalText:
Build's clean now, exit code 0.

The wall of deprecation warnings was just noise from the bump, but two real bugs were hiding in it, both from an options-shape change the new bundler made:

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now hands modules `retryCount`. Fixed to read the new field.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated an unset backoff flag as invalid and threw. The new config loader leaves it `undefined` instead of `false`, so I made `undefined` mean "disabled" too.

Build now finishes with 0 errors, 8 warnings, all just the deprecation noise.
